appraisal_events.evidence: faisant penser à certains neurasthéniques au nombre desquels mon grand-père comptait ma tante Léonie, qui nous offrent sans changement au cours des années le spectacle des habitudes bizarres qu'ils se croient chaque fois à la veille de secouer et qu'ils gardent toujours; pris dans l'engrenage de leurs malaises et de leurs manies, les efforts... ne font qu'assurer le fonctionnement et faire jouer le déclic de leur diététique étrange, inéluctable et funeste.
appraisal_events.explanation: The trapped, endlessly repeating water lily prompts a comparison, attributed to the grandfather, that classes tante Léonie among neurasthenics locked in bizarre, self-perpetuating and ultimately baleful habits; the narrator's own extended elaboration of the image sustains rather than undercuts the judgment.

status_effects.explanation: She is diminished by being classed among neurasthenics whose futile efforts to change only reinforce their strange and disastrous habits, though the framing is more pitying ('pauvre plante') than scornful.

ambiguities: The classification of tante Léonie as a neurasthenic is explicitly attributed to the grandfather ('mon grand-père comptait'), but the extended, sympathetic-yet-damning elaboration that follows reads as the narrator's own voice, so the balance between relaying the grandfather's judgment and the narrator's own endorsement is not fully certain.
